title: Nimble Irish Pepper Hash
description: A light and pillowy Irish dish featuring peppers, perfect for a quick weeknight meal or brunch.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced bacon and cook until crispy, about 6 minutes.
Remove the cooked bacon from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Add the chopped onion and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, thyme, and paprika to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir the cooked bacon back into the skillet and season with flaky sea salt.
Create 4-6 wells in the vegetables and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook until the eggs are almost set, about 10-12 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped chives.
Serve the Nimble Irish Pepper Hash hot and enjoy!
